posts.text: Healthy habits are harder when your brain resists repetition.
The ADHD urge to fix your entire life in one afternoon.
I use soundtracks for focus — because silence is too loud for ADHD.
Society rewards women who mask their ADHD until they collapse.
Living with ADHD forgets what I’m doing halfway through doing it and honestly, I’m proud of the chaos.

You didn't get the ADHD support as a kid. New research keeps showing that early diagnosis builds structure that lasts into adulthood, and if that wasn't you, it's okay to grieve that a little. But the scaffolding isn't only for kids. A visual calendar, a body double, a system that outsources your memory, you can build that now. It's not catching up late, it's catching up smart. We're building guides to help with exactly this kind of scaffolding if you want somewhere to start.
